# PyMoDAQ

> PyMoDAQ (Python Modular Data Acquisition) is a Python framework to acquire data and drive instruments from a graphical Dashboard (control modules, scans, extensions) or from scripts. Instruments are supported by *plugins*: Python packages named `pymodaq_plugins_<name>` created from the plugin template. This index points first to what is needed to write or fix a plugin, then to extensions and applications, the data model and remote control. The full text of the documentation is in llms-full.txt, next to this file.

## Write an instrument plugin

- [Your first plugin in 10 minutes](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/tutorials/first_plugin.html): one complete actuator and one complete detector for a made-up instrument, each under 80 lines, and the test that runs them without hardware. Start here.
- [Instrument plugins](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/developer_folder/instrument_plugins.html): the reference: naming rules, the methods of a plugin and which are required, `check_plugin` and its rules (PMQxxx), tests, plugins working on some systems only (`supported_platforms`), emitting data.
- [Story of an instrument plugin development](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/tutorials/plugin_development.html): the long, step by step tutorial, with screenshots, on a real instrument.
- [Plugin template and AGENTS.md](https://github.com/PyMoDAQ/pymodaq_plugins_template): repository to start a plugin from; its AGENTS.md holds the rules for AI coding assistants.
- [Mock plugins](https://github.com/PyMoDAQ/pymodaq_plugins_mock): reference plugins that run without hardware (actuators and detectors of every dimension).

## Extensions and standalone applications

- [CustomApp and CustomExt](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/developer_folder/custom_app.html): write a standalone application or a Dashboard extension.
- [Extension plugins](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/developer_folder/extension_plugins.html): the extensions shipped with PyMoDAQ and how to write one.

## Data model

- [Data objects](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/data_management/data_objects.html): `DataWithAxes`, `DataToExport`, axes and their units, the classes every plugin exchanges.
- [Saving and loading data](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/data_management/saving_loading_data.html): the HDF5 saver and loader.

## Use and control PyMoDAQ

- [Quick start](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/quick_start.html): installation and first launch.
- [Scripting](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/user_folder/scripting.html): drive a running Dashboard from Python (`pymodaq_scripting`), the safe way to prototype against a real setup.
- [Control modules](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/modules/Control_Modules.html): DAQ_Move, DAQ_Viewer and the Dashboard.

## Reference

- [API documentation](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/api/api_doc.html): generated from the docstrings.
- [Glossary](https://pymodaq.cnrs.fr/en/stable/glossary.html)
